+"""Bind capability templates to concrete, server-authorized task resources."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from agentforge.contracts.agent_definition import AgentDefinition, Budget, Permissions, TOOL_CAPABILITIES, ToolName
+
+
+class ScopeDenied(PermissionError):
+    """A capability or a referenced resource is outside the current task."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TaskContext:
+    """Internal service context; never deserialize this from model/tool arguments.
+
+    Resource sets in every grant ceiling must be concrete. Context references
+    are opaque immutable IDs validated by the application's resource resolver.
+    """
+
+    user_id: UUID
+    project_id: UUID
+    task_id: UUID
+    platform_permissions: Permissions
+    user_permissions: Permissions
+    task_permissions: Permissions
+    parent_permissions: Permissions
+    platform_budget: Budget
+    tier_budget: Budget
+    task_budget: Budget
+    parent_budget: Budget
+    authorized_context_refs: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+    depth: int = 0
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EffectiveScope:
+    permissions: Permissions
+    allowed_tools: tuple[ToolName, ...]
+    budget: Budget
+    context_refs: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+def intersect_and_validate(
+    definition: AgentDefinition, ctx: TaskContext, context_refs: tuple[str, ...],
+) -> EffectiveScope:
+    if ctx.depth != 0:
+        raise ScopeDenied("nested sub-agent delegation is disabled")
+    # Round-trip through JSON revalidates even models constructed with model_copy.
+    definition = AgentDefinition.model_validate_json(definition.model_dump_json())
+    ceilings = [Permissions.model_validate_json(p.model_dump_json()) for p in (
+        ctx.platform_permissions, ctx.user_permissions, ctx.task_permissions, ctx.parent_permissions,
+    )]
+    values: dict[str, object] = {}
+    for name in Permissions.model_fields:
+        if name.startswith("allowed_"):
+            grants = [getattr(p, name) for p in ceilings]
+            if any(grant is None for grant in grants):
+                raise ScopeDenied(f"missing concrete authorization ceiling: {name}")
+            resource_set = set(grants[0])
+            for grant in grants[1:]:
+                resource_set.intersection_update(grant)
+            requested = getattr(definition.permissions, name)
+            if requested is not None:
+                resource_set.intersection_update(requested)
+            values[name] = tuple(sorted(resource_set))
+        else:
+            values[name] = all(getattr(p, name) for p in [*ceilings, definition.permissions])
+    permissions = Permissions.model_validate(values)
+    references = set(context_refs)
+    if not references.issubset(ctx.authorized_context_refs) or not references.issubset(permissions.allowed_context_refs or ()):
+        raise ScopeDenied("context reference is not authorized for this task")
+    if len(references) != len(context_refs):
+        raise ScopeDenied("duplicate context references")
+    budgets = [Budget.model_validate_json(b.model_dump_json()) for b in (
+        ctx.platform_budget, ctx.tier_budget, ctx.task_budget, ctx.parent_budget, definition.budget,
+    )]
+    budget = Budget.model_validate({name: min(getattr(b, name) for b in budgets) for name in Budget.model_fields})
+    tools = tuple(tool for tool in definition.allowed_tools if all(
+        getattr(permissions, flag) for flag in TOOL_CAPABILITIES[tool]
+    ))
+    if not tools:
+        raise ScopeDenied("no tools remain within the authorized grant intersection")
+    return EffectiveScope(permissions, tools, budget, context_refs)

+"""Ownership and resource checks shared by spawn and every tool call.
+
+Public URL adapters must resolve and pin public DNS addresses, disable automatic
+redirects, and run validate_public_url again for every redirect/new connection.
+URL lexical validation alone is deliberately not presented as SSRF protection.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from ipaddress import ip_address
+from pathlib import PurePosixPath
+import re
+from typing import Any
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+from sqlalchemy import select
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

+from agentforge.database.models import Project, Task
+from agentforge.subagents.scope import EffectiveScope, ScopeDenied, TaskContext
+
+
+class AuthorizationService:
+    def __init__(self, session: Session):
+        self.session = session
+
+    async def check_context(self, ctx: TaskContext) -> None:
+        # Query afresh on every boundary so cached contexts do not preserve
+        # access after ownership changes. Membership expansion is not MVP scope.
+        owner = self.session.scalar(select(Project.id).where(
+            Project.id == ctx.project_id, Project.owner_id == ctx.user_id,
+        ))
+        task = self.session.scalar(select(Task.id).where(
+            Task.id == ctx.task_id, Task.project_id == ctx.project_id,
+            Task.created_by == ctx.user_id,
+        ))
+        if owner is None or task is None:
+            raise ScopeDenied("task/project ownership is not authorized")
+
+
+def validate_relative_path(path: str) -> str:
+    if not path or len(path) > 1024 or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in path):
+        raise ScopeDenied("invalid resource path")
+    decoded = unquote(path)
+    parts = decoded.split("/")
+    if decoded != path or "\\" in path or ":" in path or PurePosixPath(path).is_absolute():
+        raise ScopeDenied("resource path must be a literal relative POSIX path")
+    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts):
+        raise ScopeDenied("resource path traversal is forbidden")
+    forbidden = {".git", ".ssh", ".aws", ".config", ".gnupg"}
+    if any(part.lower() in forbidden or part.lower().startswith(".env") for part in parts):
+        raise ScopeDenied("sensitive resource path is forbidden")
+    return path
+
+
+def validate_ref(ref: str) -> str:
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]{0,199}", ref):
+        raise ScopeDenied("invalid repository ref")
+    if any(value in ref for value in ("..", "//", "@{")) or ref.endswith(("/", ".", ".lock")):
+        raise ScopeDenied("unsafe repository ref")
+    if any(part.startswith(".") or part.endswith(".lock") for part in ref.split("/")):
+        raise ScopeDenied("unsafe repository ref")
+    return ref
+
+

+class PublicURL:
+    url: str
+    hostname: str
+    addresses: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+def validate_public_url(
+    url: str, allowed_hosts: tuple[str, ...], *, resolved_addresses: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
+) -> PublicURL:
+    if len(url) > 4096 or any(ord(c) < 33 for c in url) or "\\" in url:
+        raise ScopeDenied("invalid public URL")
+    try:
+        parsed = urlsplit(url)
+        port = parsed.port
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ScopeDenied("invalid public URL") from exc
+    host = parsed.hostname
+    if parsed.scheme != "https" or not host or parsed.username or parsed.password or parsed.fragment or port not in (None, 443):

+    addresses = resolved_addresses or ((str(literal),) if literal else ())
+    if not addresses:

Implemented:

- Strict immutable definition, budget, permission, spawn and specialized result contracts.
- Four packaged versioned built-in JSON definitions.
- Source/DB registry with exact namespaces, canonical hashes, immutable versions, bounded discovery, owner-only custom saves and soft disabling.
- Permission/resource intersection, fresh ownership checks, safe path/ref validation and public URL guards.

Source-reviewed runtime integration and reported fixes to its owner. No tests, builds, migrations, provider calls or commits executed. Deleted `.env.example` preserved.

Limitations: URL fetch/browser remain blocked pending DNS pinning adapters; repository grants authorize whole repositories without pinned-ref enforcement; evidence ownership and semantic verification require later integrations.
